messages:
adele: starting staged canary for rwd-infer-embed v1.4.0 -> 10% traffic (EU-west changewindow 03:30-05:30). watchers @tomas @lee. new embedding sharding logic in this build; runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/canary-fallback :mag:

deploy-bot: canary initiated · id=cb-20260322-3 · region=eu-west · hosts=12 · traffic=10% · health=nominal (initial)

tomas: quick heads-up — low recall on a small eval set for embeddings route at 03:42, similarity drop ~12% vs baseline. still small sample but consistent across two hosts. :warning:

lee: saw the same in traces. also intermittent rate-limit 429s on shard-2. could be the sharding key change causing hot-spot. suggest immediate fallback to last stable (v1.3.7) and run backout-runbook for sharding regressions: https://go/redwood/runbooks/backouts/embed-shard

adele: agree with fallback. plan: 1) pin embeddings route to v1.3.7 2) scale canary down to 0% 3) run validation smoke (recall + QPS) 4) open incident and update release notes. doing pin now.

adele: ```
# API pin for embeddings-only route
curl -X POST "https://deploybot.redwood/api/pin" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"service":"rwd-infer-embed","route":"/embed","version":"v1.3.7","reason":"canary recall regression / shard hotspots"}'
```

deploy-bot: pin request accepted · pin_id=pin-1779009999 · route=/embed · status=applying · rolling-drain=starting

nora: drafting a short note for PG + support: "Canary v1.4.0 for embeddings rolled back in EU-west due to recall regressions and shard hotspots. Reverted embeddings to v1.3.7 while we investigate. Incident INC-2026-2044 opened." will post once rollback done. :pencil2:

tomas: attaching quick log snippet from shard-2 around 03:43 — shows hotspot errors not OOM: 
```
WARN rwd-infer-embed-12 shard=2 request_id=6732 hot_key_detected count=874 window=60s
ERROR router shard=2 failed dispatch: shard-mapping-mismatch -> fallback-to-master
```

lee: that's consistent with new sharding logic mis-assigning some keys. good that it's graceful fallback but recall suffers. will add a step in runbook to include a small synthetic long-tail key-scan before next canary.

deploy-bot: rolling-drain complete · canary-id=cb-20260322-3 · status=drained · rollback initiated -> target_version=v1.3.7 · rollback_job=rb-1779010008

adele: @nora please post the customer-facing blurb after you link the incident. keep it brief: "We temporarily rolled back embeddings to a stable version due to an internal quality regression; no customer data exposure. Investigating root cause; will update."

nora: posted to PG and #support-ops. created INC-2026-2044 and linked runbook. also added a note to release notes: "v1.4.0 deferred: embedding sharding work requires further QA." :white_check_mark:

tomas: monitoring after rollback — recall back to baseline within two minutes, QPS stable. leaving extra watch for 15m to ensure no residual shard misroutes.

lee: next steps: add a synthetic key distribution test to the canary harness, include shard-key histograms in observability, and add an automated preflight that runs a tiny long-tail lookup sweep for new sharding code. I'll update runbook accordingly.

adele: thanks team. tagging owners: @lee (runbook + tests), @tomas (monitoring + traces), @nora (comm + ticket). closing this canary thread and scheduling a follow-up postmortem.

deploy-bot: summary: canary cb-20260322-3 rolled back -> pinned to v1.3.7 · timeline: start=1779009999 · rollback_job=1779010008 · closed=1779010120

adele: filing follow-up items on the release board now."
